text: Q: How do I apply for scholarships and financial aid? A: Students can apply for: Government scholarships (SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority). Merit-based scholarships through the college. Financial aid is processed via online state government portals.

metadata.title: How do I apply for scholarships and financial aid?

text: Q: What are the library timings and rules? A: The library usually operates during college hours (9:40 AM – 5:30 PM). Borrowing limits depend on the student’s program. Books must be returned on time; late returns attract a fine.

metadata.title: What are the library timings and rules?

text: Q: How do I get a student ID card? A: After admission confirmation, the college issues ID cards through the administrative office.

metadata.title: How do I get a student ID card?

text: Q: What are the hostel rules and accommodation facilities? A: Separate hostels for boys and girls. Rules include maintaining discipline, fixed entry/exit timings, and prohibition of ragging/alcohol.

metadata.title: What are the hostel rules and accommodation facilities?

text: Q: How can I contact academic advisors or departments? A: Each department has a Head of Department (HoD) and faculty advisors. Students can approach them during office hours or via departmental email.

metadata.title: How can I contact academic advisors or departments?

text: Q: What extracurricular clubs and activities are available? A: NCC, NSS, Entrepreneurship Development Cell, Cultural clubs, Technical clubs, Sports clubs.

metadata.title: What extracurricular clubs and activities are available?

text: Q: How is attendance calculated and what is the minimum requirement? A: Attendance is calculated per subject. Generally, 75% attendance is mandatory as per JNTUH norms.

metadata.title: How is attendance calculated and what is the minimum requirement?

text: Q: What is the college’s examination schedule and result policy? A: Exams are conducted as per the academic calendar. Results are published on the official website (autonomous portals).

metadata.title: What is the college’s examination schedule and result policy?

text: Q: How do I access online learning resources or study materials? A: Through college LMS, digital library, NPTEL/SWAYAM courses, and department portals.

metadata.title: How do I access online learning resources or study materials?

text: Q: What is the process for submitting assignments or project reports? A: Assignments are submitted to respective faculty (hardcopy or online). Final project reports must follow JNTUH guidelines and be submitted through the department.

metadata.title: What is the process for submitting assignments or project reports?

text: Q: How do I get academic counseling or support services? A: Students can approach their faculty advisors, HoDs, or counseling cell for academic or personal support.

metadata.title: How do I get academic counseling or support services?

text: Q: What are the rules for discipline and code of conduct? A: Students are expected to follow the college code of conduct, maintain discipline, wear ID cards, avoid ragging, and behave responsibly on campus.

metadata.title: What are the rules for discipline and code of conduct?

text: Q: How and when do I withdraw or transfer from the college? A: A written application must be submitted to the principal/administrative office, along with required documents. Approvals depend on JNTUH/AICTE norms.

metadata.title: How and when do I withdraw or transfer from the college?

text: Q: What are the library borrowing limits and penalties? A: Typically, 2–4 books per student for 2–3 weeks. Late return incurs a fine per day.

metadata.title: What are the library borrowing limits and penalties?

text: Q: Are there facilities for differently-abled students? A: Yes – ramps, accessible toilets, and exam support (extra time/scribes) are provided as per government guidelines.

metadata.title: Are there facilities for differently-abled students?

text: Q: What are the safety and emergency protocols on campus? A: Emergency contacts are displayed on campus. The college has a medical facility, anti-ragging committee, fire safety measures, and security guards.

metadata.title: What are the safety and emergency protocols on campus?
